title: HermesTV Media Metadata
description: Extended editorial/metadata record for a VOD, series, or episode. Uses mock IDs only — no real TMDB or IMDB identifiers.

tmdb_mock_id.description: Fake TMDB-style identifier for offline mock use only. Never a real TMDB ID.

imdb_mock_id.description: Fake IMDB-style identifier for offline mock use only. Never a real IMDB ID.

plot.description: Short plot synopsis. Hard limit 500 characters.

runtime_min.description: Runtime in minutes. Null for series-level records; set on episode records.

cast.description: Ordered array of actor_id strings. Cross-reference with actors list in catalog.

language.description: Primary spoken language (BCP-47 or plain English label).
